name: Sundome Tenshi to Sakusei Akuma -Endless Nuki Jigoku Tengoku-
original_name: 寸止め天使と搾精悪魔-エンドレスヌキ地獄天国-
source:
Seduced by an angel, she draws you ever closer to the edge...
Then when it's the devil's turn, she expects you to cum over and over...
You've got it in you, right?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ274832.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
受到天使的诱惑，她将你拉近了边缘……
然后轮到魔鬼时，她会期待你一次又一次地射精……
你心里有它，对吧？

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ274832.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
